gr_11a_format.grants-bundle.json: JCS (RFC 8785, float-free), keys schema_version=1, bundle_version (git SHA), built_at (RFC 3339 UTC, seconds, Z), tenants {tenant: {grants: <file with group subjects expanded; groups map kept for approval requesters/approvers>, approval_policy: <file or null>}}, platform: <registry>
gr_11a_format.grants-bundle.json.sig: JCS JSON {alg: EdDSA, kid, sig: base64url no padding of Ed25519 over exact bundle bytes}
gr_11a_format.signing_key: secret GXG_BUNDLE_SIGNING_KEY = base64url 32-byte Ed25519 seed; vars GXG_BUNDLE_KID, GXG_BUNDLE_PUBLIC_KEY (docs/setup/bundle-signing.md)
gr_11a_format.platform.services[].tools: built from connectors/<id>/gxg-manifest.yaml (connector == service id) for every kind: connector service: name, version, effect_class, action, executes_via?, dispatch_timeout_s?, preview?; no manifest -> []; hand-written registry tools are replaced (lint warning ignored-tools; none left in the repo example)
gr_11a_format.schema: build and verify validate the document by schemas/grants-bundle.schema.json

spec_interpretations: groups stay in the bundled grants file next to expanded subjects (approval policies reference groups) — for M1 loader alignment
platform registry: the single *.yaml in policies/platform/ (spec names registry.yaml, repo ships registry.example.yaml)
tenant file name is not checked against `tenant` (repo example is example.yaml with tenant t-alpha)
foreign principal detected by tenant segment of agent:<tenant>:<name> (spec marks the format VERIFY)
rewritten `match` of a rule is widening (fail closed), except requesters of auto_approve rules, which are compared as expanded sets (added -> widening, removed -> narrowing)
'*' / absent approvers or requesters means everyone: '*' -> specific is narrowing
AP-02 classes and bundle tools come from the same manifest set, default connectors/*/gxg-manifest.yaml (schemas/examples no longer counts): lint checks exactly what AS-26 enforces
manifests are schema-checked by gxg-manifest.schema.json; a bad manifest is a lint error with file and path

manifest diff key is (connector, tool name): a tool moved to another connector is removed + added (widening); only effect_class, action, executes_via and the tool list are compared (they decide who approves); a duplicate tool name across manifests is a lint error

every file changed under the gate paths (.github/workflows/, scripts/ci/, tools/gxg-policy/, schemas/, pyproject.toml, uv.lock) counts as widening (kind gate_path), including tests and fixtures under those paths: fail closed
